notes.subject: wĩira wa mahenĩ
notes.rationale: בשלוה nĩ 'ũiguũrũru' (gĩtĩeva kana gĩtĩeva-gĩa-mahenĩ); 'wĩira wa mahenĩ' ĩnoanĩria gĩtĩeva gĩa kwĩhoka nĩguo ahonie

notes.subject: mwathi wa amiathi
notes.rationale: שר שרים — 'mwathi wa amiathi' kana 'Mwathi wa amiathi' (Erohimu); maandĩko matarĩ Rĩĩtwa ũguo, nĩgeetha gĩtikũmenyeka ũrĩa ũkwĩrĩgwo

notes.subject: handũ ha moko
notes.rationale: אפס יד = 'kũhia kwa moko' — kũcoorũkwo atĩrĩ ndũngata ya moko ya mũndũ; KJV 'without hand'

notes.subject: thiomi cia nyonerere
notes.rationale: ciugo iria ciumanĩtia nyonerere ya hinda ya ũtukũ na ũtheri, irĩ ya kũnyitĩrwo thayũ thayũ (8:26)

translation: Na thĩinĩ ithenya rĩake nĩkahotithia ũthiangũ moko-inĩ make, na ngoro-inĩ yake nĩkaĩtigitha ũkũru, na thĩiniĩ wĩira wa mahenĩ nĩkahonia andũ aingĩ, na thĩinĩ mwathi wa amiathi nĩkĩmamũkĩra, na handũ ha moko nĩgũcoorũkwo.
